_comment: Universal Golden Path template for multi-step media production. The engine reads this file when --dispatch-template is passed (or the user invokes the built-in shortcut `pwsh skill.ps1 --recipe media-tutorial-video`), substitutes {{project_title}}, {{source_markdown}}, {{voice}}, {{bgm_mood}}, {{aspect}}, and {{slide_count}} from the master objective, and dispatches the resulting master objective through the media-stack agent. Works for tutorial videos, ad cuts, narrated slide decks, social clips, podcast covers -- any case where one markdown / script source becomes a finished media deliverable with N slides, N voiceover segments, one BGM, and a final edit.
name: media-tutorial-video
objective_template:
{{project_title}} -- media-tutorial-video recipe

Source: {{source_markdown}} (read this file as the canonical content).
Voice: {{voice}}  BGM mood: {{bgm_mood}}  Aspect: {{aspect}}  Slide count: {{slide_count}}

## Required deliverables
  1. Storyboard (markdown) -- one beat per slide, with the visual brief + the spoken copy
  2. Hero image per slide ({{slide_count}} images, 16:9, 1K)
  3. Voiceover per slide ({{slide_count}} audio segments, {{voice}})
  4. Background music loop (one track, {{bgm_mood}}, loops under all slides)
  5. Final MP4 -- {{slide_count}} slides @ ~6s each, voiceover mixed with BGM, exported to deliverables/<project>/<project_title>.mp4

## Continuity rules
  - All hero images share the same art style and color palette (specify both in the image brief)
  - All voiceover uses the {{voice}} voice -- no per-slide voice switching
  - BGM loops under the entire video; no per-slide genre change
  - Aspect: {{aspect}} throughout
  - Pacing: ~6 seconds per slide; voiceover duration must match the slide hold time

## High-stakes gates
  - Gate 1 (HIGH) after storyboard + voiceover script drafted -- operator approves the script before media generation begins
  - Gate 2 (CRITICAL) after all hero images + voiceover + BGM generated -- operator approves the visual + audio assembly before final cut
  - Gate 3 (HIGH) after final MP4 is rendered -- operator approves the deliverable before it's written to the durable deliverables/<project>/ folder

substitutions.project_title: Human-readable project name, e.g. 'VORTEX-OS introduction tutorial' or 'Acme Q2 product launch ad'
substitutions.source_markdown: Absolute path to the source markdown / script file, e.g. 'walkthrough/README.md' or 'briefs/acme_q2_brief.md'
substitutions.voice: Voice preset, one of: default | male-1 | female-1 | child
substitutions.bgm_mood: Mood / genre for the BGM, free-text, e.g. 'cinematic orchestral', 'lo-fi hip-hop', 'upbeat corporate', 'ambient pad'
substitutions.aspect: Output aspect ratio, one of: 16:9 (desktop) | 9:16 (short-form / mobile) | 1:1 (social)
substitutions.slide_count: Integer, typically 5-15 for a tutorial, 1-3 for a short ad

deliverables.name: storyboard
deliverables.description: Storyboard with one beat per slide: slide number, visual brief, spoken copy, hold time.

deliverables.name: hero_image_per_slide
deliverables.description: One hero image per slide, generated by image-cover with the project's pinned art style + palette.

deliverables.name: voiceover_per_slide
deliverables.description: One TTS segment per slide using the {{voice}} preset, generated by audio-voice.

deliverables.name: background_music_loop
deliverables.description: One BGM track ({{bgm_mood}}) that loops under all slides, generated by audio-music.

deliverables.name: final_video
deliverables.description: {{slide_count}} slides @ ~6s each, voiceover mixed with BGM, exported by media-ffmpeg. The final packager writes this to deliverables/<project>/{{project_title}}.mp4.

hitl_gates.ask: Approve the storyboard + voiceover script for media generation?
Approve the visual + audio assembly for final cut? (this is the last chance to revise heroes or voiceover before the MP4 is rendered)
Approve the final pack for delivery to deliverables/<project>/?

self_heal_targets: Tone drift (voiceover shifts formality or speed between slides)
Style drift (hero images drift in art style between slides)
Color drift (hero images don't share the same palette as the cover)
Pacing mismatch (voiceover duration doesn't match the slide's visual hold time)
Audio level mismatch (voiceover too quiet vs BGM, or vice versa)
dispatch_examples: # Master-objective dispatch (if you want to write the objective by hand):
Voice: default  BGM mood: cinematic orchestral  Aspect: 16:9  Slide count: 11
(... see objective_template above for the full objective ...)
